title: AI Assistant
description: An in-app assistant answering questions about a citation, the rulebook, or the portal — with full token/cost accounting.

title: Audit & History
description: The append-only event log and per-row audit trail that coexist with the computed current state.

title: Auth & Identity
description: Authentication, session, impersonation, and the live per-request identity resolution that drives role, redaction, and licensing.

title: Dashboards
description: Analytics and operational dashboards for reps, managers, and outcome feedback.

title: Data Model
description: Underlying schema and entities that back a feature surface.

title: DevOps & Tooling
description: Build pipeline, code generation, and operational plumbing.

title: Hearings & Contests
description: Requesting, scheduling, and recording the outcome of a contested-citation hearing.

title: Intake & Response
description: Getting a citation into the system and capturing the driver's response (pay or contest) before the deadline.

title: Reference Library
description: Glossary, business rules, and per-jurisdiction source documents that explain how the system decides.

title: License & Points
description: Rolling up active points to drive the Valid → Warning → Suspended license track.

title: Packages & Licensing
description: Package enable/disable, per-feature/table/route licensing toggles, and the vendor-only unlicensed-surface model that the whole UI responds to.

title: Navigation & Routing
description: The route designer, the live DB-driven sidebar, role URL worlds, and per-route access gating — how users move through the platform.

title: Payments & Penalties
description: Paying fines, computing late penalties, and tracking the slide into collections.

title: Permissions & RBAC
description: The role→table→field CRUD cascade, per-role WHERE policies, PII redaction, and the derived row-level security that enforces it all in Postgres.

title: Platform & Meta
description: Cross-cutting platform machinery: permissions, RLS, state machines, and the self-describing meta layer.

title: Rules Engine
description: Multi-jurisdiction regulations as data: deadlines, fines, penalties, and point thresholds are rows, not hardcoded constants.

title: State Machines
description: The four computed tracks — Citation, Contest, Payment, License — that derive current status from facts + rules on every read.

title: Work Queue & Deadlines
description: Surfacing what needs attention now: overdue responses, due payments, and upcoming hearings.
